goal: Change the post code for member 40055 to S2 7QQ and report the post code the confirmation screen shows
description: Changed the post code for member 40055. Entered 'S2 7QQ' in the Post Code field on the Contact Details page and clicked Save Details. The DETAILS AMENDED confirmation screen showed 'Post Code S2 7Q' — the application truncated the value to 5 characters, dropping the final Q. Reloading Contact Details for member 40055 confirmed the stored value is 'S2 7Q', not the full 'S2 7QQ' that was entered.
